description: This file defines the HL7DAO interface for database operations related to HL7 messaging components within the OpenMRS system, including methods for saving, retrieving, and deleting HL7 sources, queues, archives, and errors.

classes.name: HL7DAO
classes.description: Interface defining database operations for HL7 messaging components such as sources, queues, archives, and errors within the OpenMRS HL7 module.

methods.name: saveHL7Source
methods.description: Saves an HL7Source entity to the database.

methods.name: getHL7Source
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7Source by ID.

methods.name: getHL7SourceByName
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7Source by its name.

methods.name: getAllHL7Sources
methods.description: Returns a list of all HL7Source entities.

methods.name: deleteHL7Source
methods.description: Deletes an HL7Source from the database.

methods.name: saveHL7InQueue
methods.description: Saves an HL7InQueue entity to the database.

methods.name: getHL7InQueue
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InQueue by ID.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InQueue by UUID.

methods.name: getAllHL7InQueues
methods.description: Returns a list of all HL7InQueue entities.

methods.name: getNextHL7InQueue
methods.description: Retrieves the next HL7InQueue for processing.

methods.name: deleteHL7InQueue
methods.description: Deletes an HL7InQueue from the database.

methods.name: getHL7Batch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of HL7 entities based on class, start, length, and query.

methods.name: countHL7s
methods.description: Counts the number of HL7 entities of a given class, filtered by message state and query.

methods.name: saveHL7InArchive
methods.description: Saves an HL7InArchive entity to the database.

methods.name: getHL7InArchive
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InArchive by ID.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InArchive by UUID.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByState
methods.description: Retrieves HL7InArchives by their state.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueByState
methods.description: Retrieves HL7InQueue items by their state.

methods.name: getAllHL7InArchives
methods.description: Returns all HL7InArchive entities.

methods.name: getAllHL7InArchives
methods.description: Returns a limited set of HL7InArchive entities for memory efficiency.

methods.name: deleteHL7InArchive
methods.description: Deletes an HL7InArchive entity.

methods.name: getHL7InArchivesToMigrate
methods.description: Retrieves a list of HL7InArchive entities pending migration.

methods.name: saveHL7InError
methods.description: Saves an HL7InError entity to the database.

methods.name: getHL7InError
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InError by ID.

methods.name: getHL7InErrorByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InError by UUID.

methods.name: getAllHL7InErrors
methods.description: Returns a list of all HL7InError entities.

methods.name: deleteHL7InError
methods.description: Deletes an HL7InError from the database.

methods.name: garbageCollect
methods.description: Performs garbage collection to clean up resources.
